subject: Prospect requests pause: Veridian LLM pilot — rebook in Q1
messages:
From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@veridian.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@veridian.io>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot — request to pause

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Unfortunately, our product org has reprioritized work against a hard launch the week of Oct 11 — several engineers are being pulled to that effort and we have a temporary hiring freeze for new pilots.

Given that, could we pause the scheduled demo and rebook for early January? We want to avoid an under-resourced pilot that would give a poor signal for both teams. Carlos and I can reconvene after the launch and pick this back up.

For visibility I attached a short prioritization note (internal). Please let me know if you need anything else from our side.

Appreciate your flexibility — Emily

Emily Nguyen
Head of AI Programs, Veridian Systems
emily.nguyen@veridian.io
+1 415-555-0134

[Attachment: veridian_prioritization_summary.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@veridian.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot — request to pause

Hi Emily — thank you for the update and for sending the prioritization note. Totally understand the pull to a launch — that happens.

Options we can do now:
- Move the demo out and put the deal on a Q1 re-engage cadence (we'll set a follow-up in Jan)
- Keep a short 30-min technical sync (no heavy infra work) so you have a record of feasibility once the team frees up
- Share a one-pager summary and a small set of benchmarks you can hand to product/execs to speed the restart

If you'd like the first option I can mark the HubSpot deal as "nurture" and remove the demo from calendars. If you'd prefer a lightweight sync, suggest Oct 26 or Nov 9.

I'm attaching our latest Mutual Action Plan (v1) in case you want to keep a consolidated artifact.

Best,
Laura
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

[Attachment: redwood_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf]

From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@veridian.io>

Laura — thanks, option 1 works best for us. Please move the demo and set a tentative follow-up for the week of Jan 11, 2027. We'll reach back out beforehand if the launch frees up more resources and we can accelerate.

We appreciate the one-pager offer — that would be helpful to hand to our PM and legal.

Emily
